question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanation: The correct answer is D, "At the same time,". The passage first reads the charbagh layout symbolically, as an evocation of paradise described as a garden divided by four rivers. The sentence after the blank then gives a second, equally valid reading of the same design — that it was thoroughly practical, distributing scarce water and cooling the air. The two readings coexist rather than competing, so "At the same time," is the right connector. "As a result," would make the practical function a consequence of the symbolism; "In contrast," would set the two readings against each other, though both hold true; and "For example," would treat the practical reading as an instance of the symbolic one.

_meta.anchor: Mughal charbagh garden design; symbolic and practical functions [theme: Mughal garden design]

passage: The Mughal gardens of sixteenth- and seventeenth-century South Asia were laid out as a charbagh, a square divided into four quadrants by water channels meeting at the center. The design was partly symbolic, evoking descriptions of paradise as a garden divided by four rivers. ______ it was thoroughly practical: the raised walkways and sunken planting beds distributed scarce water evenly and cooled the air around the pavilions where the court gathered.
